Onboarding-Welcome-Description: Install runtimes, switch versions and keep each project on the right environment.
Onboarding-Shell-Description: Make nvmd available in your shell before you start switching versions.
Onboarding-Versions-Description: The Versions page is where you find, install and apply Node.js releases.
Onboarding-Projects-Title: Give each project its own version
Onboarding-Projects-Description: Use Projects for individual runtimes and Groups to share a version across projects.
Onboarding-Appearance-Description: Appearance and settings are available at the bottom of the sidebar.
Onboarding-Ready-Description: Start with a Node.js release, then check your environment in the terminal.
Onboarding-Feature-Projects: Assign versions to projects and groups
Onboarding-Shell-Windows: Check that the nvmd bin directory is in PATH. The usual location is shown below.
Onboarding-Shell-Help: Open a new terminal if the command is not found. You can revisit these instructions from Tips.
Onboarding-Appearance-Help: Use the palette to choose base colors, full themes, accents and corner styles.
Onboarding-Settings-Help: Settings contains language, light/dark mode, install directory, mirrors and proxy preferences.
Onboarding-Directory-Note: Changing the install directory changes which downloaded runtimes are shown. You can move existing runtime files to the new directory.
Settings-Custom-Value-Help: Choose a preset or type your own value above.
Guide-Description: A quick guide to installing Node.js and managing versions for your projects.
Guide-Install-Description: Find a release on the Versions page and select Install. Choose the architecture that matches your system.
Guide-Global: After installation, use Apply to set a release as the global default.
Guide-Project: Add project folders on the Projects page to assign their own Node.js versions.
Guide-Resolution: When {{file}} exists in the current directory, its version takes priority over the global default.
Guide-Commands: Manage your local Node.js versions with nvmd. Replace node_version with an installed version number.
Guide-Refresh: After switching versions in the terminal, refresh the app to update the displayed information.
Guide-Verify-Description: Check the active version in your terminal. If it has not updated, reopen the terminal and try again.
Onboarding-Reset-Failed: Could not reset the introduction. Please try again.
Guide-Tour: Show the introduction again the next time you open the app.
Setting-Desc: Make changes to your setting here. Click save when you're done.
Installation-Directory-tip: Please note that nvm-desktop does not keep track of all your used directories. This means that every time you change the installation directory, you need to re-download Nodejs.
App-Desc: A desktop application to manage multiple active node.js versions.

Versions-Description: Find the right runtime for your next build.
Installed-Description: Keep your local runtimes ready for every project.
Remove-Project-Effect: This removes the project from the workspace and deletes its Node.js version configuration file. The project folder and source files are kept.
Remove-Group-Effect: Projects in this group will be unassigned and their Node.js version configuration cleared. Project folders and installed Node.js versions are kept.
